title: Variable Count Bound for the Validity Formula
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape symbols and all natural numbers $n,s$, the variable count of the validity CNF for parameters $n,s$ is at most the codec width for $M,n,s$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
